tour.name: Blue Mountains Private Day Trip from Sydney: the Three Sisters, Scenic World & Wildlife
tour.subtitle: A private day in the Blue Mountains with a local guide and car: kangaroos and koalas at a wildlife park, the Three Sisters from Echo Point, the steepest railway in the world at Scenic World, bushwalks to waterfalls, and the village of Leura.

tour.overview:
West of Sydney, the Blue Mountains are a vast sandstone plateau cut by deep valleys covered in eucalyptus forest. On warm days, oil from the eucalyptus leaves hangs in the air and gives the landscape its blue haze. The Greater Blue Mountains area has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2000, for its diversity of eucalypts, and is the traditional country of the Darug and Gundungurra peoples.

This private day trip takes you there with a local guide and a car, about two hours from Sydney, with a stop to meet Australian wildlife, the classic lookouts, the rides of Scenic World and a bushwalk.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 9 hours
• Start and end: your hotel in Sydney
• Type: private tour with local guide, car and driver
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy to moderate

WHAT YOU SEE
• A wildlife park.
• Echo Point and the Three Sisters.
• Scenic World.
• Wentworth Falls.
• Leura.

WHY THIS WORKS
A private car lets you visit the lookouts early, before the coaches, and choose a bushwalk that suits you.

WHO IT SUITS
Nature lovers, families, walkers and photographers.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For the harbour and beaches, choose our Sydney highlights tour.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
The mountains are several degrees cooler than Sydney. Bushwalks involve steps; your guide adapts them to your pace.

private: Pick-up and drop-off at your hotel in Sydney

days.name: Wildlife, the Three Sisters, Scenic World, Wentworth Falls and Leura
days.description:
What to expect: the lookouts, rides and bushwalks of the Blue Mountains, with a local guide, private car and tickets.

Your guide and driver collect you at about 8:00. On the way west, you stop at Featherdale Wildlife Park to meet kangaroos and wallabies, wombats, echidnas and koalas, and see the native birds.

In the mountains, you go first to Echo Point, where the Three Sisters, three sandstone pillars, rise above the Jamison Valley; your guide tells the Aboriginal legend of the three sisters turned to stone. At Scenic World, you ride the Scenic Railway, an old coal-mine railway that drops into the valley at an incline of 52 degrees, walk the boardwalk through the rainforest, and return on the Cableway; then cross the gorge in the glass-floored Skyway, with views of the Katoomba Falls.

After lunch (not included), you take a bushwalk to the Wentworth Falls, where the water drops into the Jamison Valley, and end in Leura, a village of gardens, antique shops and cafés, before driving back to Sydney.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:00 – Pick-up in Sydney.
08:45 – Featherdale Wildlife Park.
10:30 – Echo Point and the Three Sisters.
11:15 – Scenic World rides.
13:00 – Lunch in Katoomba or Leura.
14:15 – Wentworth Falls bushwalk.
15:45 – Leura village.
17:30 – Back in Sydney.

GOOD TO KNOW
• A longer hike, such as the Grand Canyon track, can be arranged.
• Bring a warm layer.
• Blue Mountains views are clearest in the morning.

INCLUDED: private car and driver, local guide, wildlife park, Scenic World pass, bottled water, hotel pick-up and drop-off.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: none.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: How long is the drive?
faq.answer: About 1 hour 45 minutes each way from central Sydney.

faq.question: Can we hold a koala?
faq.answer: No. Holding koalas is not allowed in New South Wales, but you can get close to them.

faq.question: Is the Scenic Railway scary?
faq.answer: It is steep and short, about a minute; most people find it thrilling. You can take the Cableway both ways instead.

faq.question: Is lunch included?
faq.answer: No. Your guide suggests a café or restaurant in Katoomba or Leura.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. Children love the animals and the rides. Child seats are provided free of charge on request.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Largely. Echo Point and Scenic World are accessible; the bushwalks can be skipped.

faq.question: Can we add the Jenolan Caves?
Will we see wild kangaroos?
faq.answer: Possibly, at dawn or dusk on the way; the wildlife park guarantees a close look.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Layers, comfortable walking shoes, a hat and sun cream.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: All year. Spring and autumn are ideal; winter can be crisp and clear.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is not expected in Australia, where wages are higher, but it is always appreciated for excellent service.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
